push.title: W 3-0 vs ManJustGotTop | You: 6.3 (2nd worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 6.3 against ManJustGotTop. I'm not mad. I'm motivated, and I need you motivated too.

THE GOOD
+ 1 key pass. Making chances is a gift, and you were Santa Claus tonight.
+ Man of the Match, your 20th for us. That's a captain's performance, armband or not.
+ Misplaced passes 0, down from your usual 5. Keep stacking those bricks.
+ This result took us into promotion matches in Division 4. That's what happens when we pull the same rope.
+ Better match rating than any of their humans (6.3 vs their best 5.7). Remember that the next time you doubt yourself.

THE BAD
- On-ball actions 4, down from your usual 35. One honest look at that and we move forward.
- Your 2nd worst match performance of the season (6.3). We'll get you back up the list.
- Tackles attempted 0, from 3 in your previous match. We don't hide from that one; we fix it.

THE UGLY
! No shots. That's below the standard, and the standard doesn't move. Easy win: Follow every shot in. Rebounds are free goals for people who keep running.

Tonight's homework: Ask for it early in the half-space, where a first-time finish is on.

Hey, PhogsToffees. Smile at the goalkeeper. It confuses 'em.

I believe in you, period. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 3-0 vs ManJustGotTop | You: 6.3 (2nd worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
A 6.3 from you, BellyTb1. Bad day, good person, bright future.

THE GOOD
+ 1 shot at ManJustGotTop's goal. You were knocking on that door like you were selling encyclopedias.
+ This result took us into promotion matches in Division 4. Everybody gets a slice of that pie.
+ Giveaways 1, down from your usual 9. That's the good stuff, like the corner piece of the brownie.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 2. Bottle that and bring it next match.
+ Better match rating than any of their humans (6.3 vs their best 5.7). Small wins add up to big ones.

THE BAD
- 50% passing (1 of 2, down from your usual 76%). Quick one: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it. That's the whole secret.
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 4. Start here: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
- Shots 1, down from your usual 4. That needs to look different next time out.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. That's the gap between a good night and a great one.

THE UGLY
! Match rating 6.3, down from your usual 8.0. If the tape had a smell, that part would stink.

Repetition station: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.

BellyTb1, here's what I'd tell my own kid: You're not behind; you're just early to your comeback.

Trust the work. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 3-0 vs ManJustGotTop | You: 6.2 (worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
A 6.2, buddskees. Breathe. We'll look at the tape, find one thing, and fix it.

THE GOOD
+ Misplaced passes 0, down from your usual 7. Remember that the next time you doubt yourself.
+ This result took us into promotion matches in Division 4. Enjoy it. Then go get the next one.
+ Better match rating than any of their humans (6.2 vs their best 5.7). That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.
+ Team-high 1 tackles attempted. That's a keeper. The habit, not the position.
+ Part of a 3-0 beating of ManJustGotTop. Put that in the team scrapbook.

THE BAD
- Passes attempted 0, down from your usual 26. Coach's secret: Play with your head up between touches. You can't find a pass you never looked for.
- No shots. From the clipboard: Get across your defender at the near post. Most close-range goals come from that first-post run. Mind over matter.
- Won 0 of 1 tackles (down from your usual 49%). A little secret: Stay on your feet. Slide only when you're certain of the ball and there's somebody behind you. Easy money.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. Honest truth: that cost us.

THE UGLY
! Match rating 6.2, down from your usual 8.0. Rough? That's sandpaper with an attitude.

Five minutes of this: Ask for it early in the half-space, where a first-time finish is on.

buddskees, write this on your hand if you have to: Fall seven times, stand up eight, then ask for the ball.

Keep chipping away. - Coach Lasso
